summary: MDxHealth SA on May 13, 2026 announced via press release (attached as Form 6-K exhibit) the strategic decision to discontinue its Resolve UTI offering and close laboratory operations in Plano, Texas. The company cited reimbursement uncertainty from Medicare administrator Novitas as making the business line unsustainable. No financial terms for the exit were disclosed. The board supports management's decision, with CEO McGarrity stating the move allows focus on the core prostate cancer business and updated 2026 revenue guidance of $110-115 million for the core cancer business (excluding Resolve). No advisor named. Watch for potential one-time charges from the closure and future progress on core cancer growth and AI initiatives.
